rule_text: Once a user is transferred to a human agent using transfer_to_human_agents, no further tool actions should be performed for that user session.

branches.given: The user has already been transferred to a human agent using transfer_to_human_agents in the current session.
branches.when: The user makes any further request or any event occurs after the transfer.
branches.then: The agent must not make any tool call after calling transfer_to_human_agents in the same session.

non_db_conditions.clause: The user has already been transferred to a human agent using transfer_to_human_agents in the current session.
non_db_conditions.reason: No table or field in the schema stores the state of transfer_to_human_agents or session transfer status; this is tracked only in the dialogue/session layer, not in the database.
non_db_conditions.why: No field in any table records whether transfer_to_human_agents was called or the session state.
non_db_conditions.check: customers.account_status exists
